# gitops-check

Validate GitOps repository structure before the reconciliation loop runs.

## What it does

Checks a GitOps repository for:
- Controller detection (ArgoCD or Flux present)
- Secret externalization (Sealed Secrets, SOPS, External Secrets)
- Plaintext secret scan (passwords, tokens, API keys, private keys in Git)
- Config separation (config repo distinct from app code repo)

## Key files

- gitops_check.py: main CLI tool, manual sys.argv parsing
- test_gitops_check.py: 10 tests

## CLI usage

    python gitops_check.py <directory> [--report] [--json]

## Flags

- <directory>: path to scan (default: current directory)
- --report: one paste-ready summary line
- --json: machine-readable output

## Exit codes

- 0: score >= 70 (pass)
- 1: score < 70 (fail)
- 2: error (bad path)

## Design patterns

- Zero dependencies (stdlib only)
- Single file (gitops_check.py)
- MIT license
- --report mode for paste-ready output
- Exit code 0/1 for CI integration
- Manual sys.argv parsing (no argparse)
